sources.constraints: COL-BLOCK; BLOCK_SYSFS; D0 unprivileged, /sys/class/block geometry/identity allowlist, 32 MiB, <=4096 entries, 5 s; never read /dev/*
Per deterministic enumeration or safely read entry; preserve original entry identities

Device names from sorted(os.listdir(/sys/class/block)), skip hidden entries; match [a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+; per-device attributes in fixed tuple sequence: size,ro,removable,queue/logical_block_size,queue/physical_block_size,device/vendor,device/model,device/rev; only successful paths retained in source_paths aligned item0001..itemNNNN
Receipt source_paths stores ONLY successfully sealed original paths (including partial runs); optional absent attributes recorded unavailable_fields, not as evidence items
size is 512-byte sector count; logical/physical block sizes are byte quantities; no capacity-in-bytes derivation required

controlled_versions.methodology: AI-Assisted Software Engineering Governance Standard v1.0

scalar_oracles.size: decimal nonnegative integer, unit 512-byte-sectors; never multiply by device logical_block_size
scalar_oracles.device/vendor: bounded single-line UTF-8 string, whitespace-stripped normalized value; retain original text
scalar_oracles.device/model: bounded single-line UTF-8 string, whitespace-stripped normalized value; retain original text
scalar_oracles.device/rev: bounded single-line UTF-8 string, whitespace-stripped normalized value; retain original text

cases.expected: Typed observations use accurate per-device paths, per-original evidence IDs, correct 512-byte sector and byte units; unchanged original digests; manifest validates

cases.stimulus: sda and sda1 or device names loop1 and loop10, valid worker lexical order
cases.expected: lexical, not numerical, ordering accepted and precisely identified

cases.stimulus: Optional /device/vendor and model unavailable, others captured
cases.expected: preserve unavailable_fields without fabricating missing semantic observations or device identity

path attribute order swapped, duplicate path or duplicate device identity, lexical device order violated
